primary_source.role: canonical theoretical source; v0 documents are comparison/audit sources only

status_legend.BASE: primitive or theorem directly present in DDD_Base
status_legend.DERIVED: mathematical consequence under the stated assumptions
status_legend.APPLICATION: engineering construction of eLLM_v1, not a primitive of DDD_Base
status_legend.EMPIRICAL: must be measured on a declared dataset/domain and checkpoint

mappings.scope: Operational observation of a checkpoint's contextual hidden states; P and observable family are recorded, not interpreted as certified semantics.
Level k is the concatenation of probe groups 1..k. Exact prefix restriction is true by construction; quantization defines a declared discrete observation protocol.

mappings.concept: Indiscernability, fibres, quotient and partition refinement
mappings.scope: Equality is exact equality of quantized signatures over a declared finite domain. It is not equality of continuous activations or a universal semantic equivalence.
Closure and C_eff are computed empirically on the supplied finite object set and declared quantization step. Results are not extrapolated universally.
A conflict inside a finite signature fibre refutes factorization on that sample; no conflict supports only the finite-domain claim.

mappings.concept: Threshold, boundary status and minimum-double law
mappings.scope: Finite integer levels implement an operational discrete threshold. Boundary status is separately reported. The general supremum/intensity construction is not silently identified with this discrete implementation.
Diagonal is explicitly zero. The object metric and the quotient pseudoultrametric are named separately because they represent distinct interpretations.

mappings.concept: Empirical threshold measure and resolution curve
mappings.scope: Finite-pair distribution; does not itself establish held-out language generalization.
Tests compatibility on supplied signatures or one supplied commuting-diagram instance; not a universal proof over all inputs.

mappings.concept: Learned probes, canonical learning and meta-observation
mappings.scope: The probe functions are learned from hidden states. Their predictive usefulness is supervised by the language objective at all resolutions; their inclusion does not establish a discovered semantic invariant by itself.

mappings.concept: Prediction is separate from representation and generation
mappings.scope: The pretrained causal model generates token probabilities; learned fingerprint residuals change logits. The base logits, fingerprint logits and generated text are separate outputs.
D_obs/D_cap/D_res/D_search/D_transfer/D_constraint are operational diagnostic proxies, never statements of intrinsic cognitive incapacity.
Finite executable checks; new information is attributed only when the declared finite partitions/closure actually change.
Branches are model-generated candidates with seed/provenance; deterministic constraint checks do not certify facts or constitute external actions.
Explicitly public constraints include source; duplicate content hashes are grouped before splitting; invalid import rows are reported, not rewritten.
Search uses bounded beam/candidate generation and deterministic seed handling. It does not claim that all DDD_Base identity or bisimulation results have been implemented.
SQLite chat persistence is an application-level conversation store, not claimed to be the complete theoretical memory construct.
File hashes, row errors, field mapping and duplicate-aware split provenance. Parquet decoding requires pyarrow, explicitly installed by setup.

explicitly_not_claimed: A universal semantic meaning for learned probe coordinates
A complete implementation of every construction and theorem in the 3,922-line DDD_Base source
Empirical validity of the pretrained checkpoint or adapter in this build environment, because the model weights could not be obtained
Universal proof from finite-domain closure, factorization or threshold experiments
A world model or causal imagination merely because multiple text continuations are sampled
